Help
  • Phone and PC need the same Wi-Fi. Guest networks usually block it.
  • Windows' Game Controllers panel won't show movement. That's normal for Xbox pads; games read it fine.
  • Most games ignore the Guide button, just like with a real controller.
  • iPhones can't vibrate from a web page, so rumble shows on screen instead.
